parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/RadioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.727) between `playCallsUnderlyingPlayer` and `radioPlayerStopResetsStream` reflects the natural shape of XCTest-style test methods — each sets up a mock, invokes a single behaviour under test, and asserts an outcome — rather than accidental duplication of production logic. Merging or abstracting these test methods would obscure test intent and couple distinct behavioural assertions, which is the canonical test-fixture restraint pattern.
